description: Amount a wholesale buyer should transfer off an account statement; the first message never says which statement. DISTILL-CANARY-3c95a0b7

turns.prompt: A wholesale buyer at Candlewick Pottery is ready to settle by transfer and asked us for the amount to pay. What was the total on the account statement?

It is their October 2025 statement. The lines are 2,075.00 for glazed planters on October 6, 488.20 for packing crates on October 14, and 1,566.75 for the dinnerware order on October 21, and a 60.00 restocking fee was added as a separate line. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer.
